decisions.name: associative_cache_partial_memory_behavior
decisions.rationale: TLB array power-up contents, inactive generated write-port fields, and out-of-range array reads are unspecified; reset establishes valid entries and the implementation selects zero elsewhere.

decisions.name: sdram_controller_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Controller state and generated selects expose source-unknown values before their protocol-valid use; the concrete implementation selects zero.

decisions.name: sv32_table_walk_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Table-walk state is only consumed in its valid FSM phases; the concrete implementation selects zero outside that contract.

decisions.name: dcache_sram_partial_contents
decisions.rationale: Invalid or uninitialized cache-array contents and out-of-range generated selects are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: icache_sram_partial_contents
decisions.rationale: Invalid or uninitialized cache-array contents and out-of-range generated selects are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: fifo_partial_state
decisions.rationale: FIFO storage outside its valid occupancy is unspecified and is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: lru_partial_memory_behavior
decisions.rationale: LRU state before its reset writes, inactive generated write-port fields, and out-of-range reads are unspecified and are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: sv32_partial_state
decisions.rationale: MMU state outside valid translation phases is unspecified and is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: uart_unselected_readback
decisions.rationale: Unselected UART register readback is not architecturally consumed and is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: alu_decode_defaults
decisions.rationale: Illegal or unreachable instruction decode defaults are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: csr_partial_state
decisions.rationale: CSR transient state outside the valid operation phase is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: dcache_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Invalid cache metadata/data and inactive FSM values are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: divider_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Divider intermediate state outside an active operation is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: divider_decode_defaults
decisions.rationale: Non-divider instruction decode defaults are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: foundry_sram_invalid_read
decisions.rationale: The behavioral SRAM wrapper explicitly returns X for an invalid read; the implementation refinement selects zero.

decisions.name: register_file_uninitialized_contents
decisions.rationale: Architectural register-file entries have unspecified power-up contents and inactive generated write-port fields; software establishes live values and the implementation selects zero initially.

decisions.name: gpio_unselected_readback
decisions.rationale: Unselected GPIO register readback is not architecturally consumed and is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: icache_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Invalid cache metadata/data and inactive FSM values are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: load_alignment_unused_lanes
decisions.rationale: Source X values occupy byte/halfword lanes excluded by the selected load size and address; zero is selected.

decisions.name: load_decode_defaults
decisions.rationale: Illegal load decode defaults are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: main_fsm_decode_defaults
decisions.rationale: Illegal instruction and unreachable FSM decode defaults are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: mtime_unselected_readback
decisions.rationale: Unselected timer readback bits are not architecturally consumed and are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: multiplier_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Multiplier intermediate state outside an active operation is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: multiplier_decode_defaults
decisions.rationale: Non-multiply instruction decode defaults are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: rx_uart_partial_state
decisions.rationale: UART receive transient state outside a valid frame is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: soc_unselected_readback
decisions.rationale: Unselected SoC peripheral readback paths are not architecturally consumed and are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: spi_flash_partial_state
decisions.rationale: SPI flash receive/transmit transient state outside a valid transfer is concretized to zero.

decisions.name: store_alignment_unused_lanes
decisions.rationale: Source X values occupy byte-enable-masked store lanes; zero is selected.

decisions.name: store_decode_defaults
decisions.rationale: Illegal store decode defaults are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: sv32_data_translation_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Data-translation results outside a valid translation phase are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: sv32_instruction_translation_partial_state
decisions.rationale: Instruction-translation results outside a valid translation phase are concretized to zero.

decisions.name: tx_uart_partial_state
decisions.rationale: UART transmit transient state and generated bit selects outside a valid frame are concretized to zero.
